what: After a trial is added from its registry details page, the line under its title still says "Not monitored", right beside the message "Added to Elsewhere." A trial that was already in another watchlist keeps listing only that one. The line is drawn once when the page opens and is not redrawn after an add; the page shows the right watchlists only after a reload.

When the "Add to" picker shows a long watchlist name, the trial's title on the registry details page is squeezed into a narrow column. At 1024 x 768 the title reads one or two letters per line and the picker runs off the right edge of the window, so the end of the watchlist name cannot be seen; at 1440 x 900 the title is 130 pixels wide. The picker sizes itself to the longest name and the title's column gives way to it.

A keyboard user who presses "Add to watchlist" on the registry details page finds focus moved back to the "Add to" picker, so the next Tab goes to the button again instead of to "Open the trial". I am not sure this is a defect, because nothing is lost. The button is disabled while the add is saved, focus falls off it, and the page puts focus on the control beside it.
